bio.text: Jimmy Gomez represents California's 34th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and was elected in June 2017.
Before Congress he served four and a half years in the California State Assembly, where he chaired the Appropriations Committee.
He attended Riverside Community College, earned a B.A. in political science from UCLA and an M.A. in public policy from Harvard's Kennedy School, and lives in Eagle Rock.
